record.question:
Under the provisions of the Assam Lushai Hills District (Acquisition of Chiefs’ Rights) Act, 1954, the
     traditional system of hereditary Chieftainship was officially abolished. On which date did this abolition
     become effective within the jurisdiction of the Lushai Hills District Council?
